_about: Skills rows. `why` records the decision (not shown).

extensions.skills.your-skills.why: Is the skill list itself; the list is its home.

extensions.skills.skill-on-off.why: Per skill: each skill's switch in the list and in its panel.
extensions.skills.skill-on-off.label: Skill on or off

extensions.skills.rescan.why: A toolbar button on the list, not a preference.

extensions.skills.validate.why: Toolbar button; merged with the old separate diagnostics button (both checked every skill).

extensions.skills.preview.why: Per skill: Read its instructions, in the skill's panel.
routeToast: Its panel has Read its instructions.

extensions.skills.permissions.why: Per skill in each skill's panel; name patterns in 'Rules for groups of skills'.
extensions.skills.permissions.label: When skills may run
extensions.skills.permissions.editorHelp: A skill's name, or a pattern like doc-* for every skill whose name starts with doc-. For each, choose allow, ask or deny.

extensions.skills.pattern-permissions.why: The button on 'Rules for groups of skills'; opens the name-or-pattern editor.

extensions.skills.auto-invocation.label: Let skills start on their own
extensions.skills.auto-invocation.help: The assistant picks up a skill when it fits the job. Skills with a warning always wait for you.

extensions.skills.skills-panel.label: Skills in chat
extensions.skills.skills-panel.help: Type /skill in chat to browse and run skills, or just ask for one by name.

extensions.skills.discovery.label: Find new skills automatically
extensions.skills.discovery.help: Looks in your project's and your profile's skill folders when Puppet Master starts.

extensions.skills.auto-enable-new.label: Turn new skills on right away
extensions.skills.auto-enable-new.help: Off means a new skill arrives switched off until you've had a look at it.

extensions.skills.projection.label: Share skills with other AI tools
extensions.skills.projection.help: Copies your skills into the folders other AI coding tools read, like .claude/skills and .agents/skills.
extensions.skills.projection.why: The inventory lists sharing's states (failed, out of step) as choices; only share / don't share are choices.

extensions.skills.projection-method.label: How to share
extensions.skills.projection-method.help: A copy works everywhere. A link keeps one original, on drives that support links.

extensions.skills.context-budget-percent.label: Room for the skill list in each request
extensions.skills.context-budget-percent.help: At most this share of the model's working memory. Skills that don't fit are listed in the prompt inspector.

extensions.skills.context-budget-chars.label: Longest skill list, in characters
extensions.skills.context-budget-chars.help: A hard cap on the skill list sent to the model. The tighter of this and the share above wins.

extensions.skills.info-badges.label: Shown on each skill in the list
extensions.skills.info-badges.help: Whether it's ready, where it came from, and which personas use it.
